title: p Episodes on the Vine  mixed media series composed from the remainder as seed

concept.what: An animated mixed-media series where each episode IS one digit of p
concept.vine: each episode grows from the last like sourdough  the starter never stops
concept.seed: the remainder (0.14159) IS the pilot  5 micro-episodes that seed everything
concept.format: short episodes (p minutes = 3:08 each), vine-length, composable, never terminates

the_remainder_as_pilot.title: 0.14159  The Chipmunk's Theme

episodes.title: NULL
episodes.visual: black screen ? first pixel appears ? night sky blue bleeds in
episodes.audio: silence ? one C4 tone emerging from nothing
episodes.discovery: null is the anti-axis  the absence that makes directions possible

episodes.title: IDENTITY
episodes.visual: a single dot appears on the blue ? leaves a trail ? the trail IS the line
episodes.audio: organ drone + single lute pluck on D
episodes.discovery: 1 = identity, own hair same heat, the first observer

episodes.title: CHAIR
episodes.visual: four dots form the chair constellation ? Cassiopeia W ? carbon lattice
episodes.audio: piano I-V-vi-IV progression, the 4 chords = 4 bonds of carbon
episodes.discovery: all chairs  constellation, zodiac, carbon conformation, your chair

episodes.title: RETURN
episodes.visual: the image mirrors ? left hand ? right hand ? rotation disagrees
episodes.audio: the melody inverts  same notes, opposite direction (retrograde)
episodes.discovery: chirality  3 axes agree, rotation disagrees, the twist IS 0.14159

episodes.title: BOUND
episodes.visual: 5 dots = 5 senses = 5 relays = pentatonic ? the horizon appears ? CLEAR
episodes.audio: synth cluster, stacked fourths, life doesn't resolve, chipmunk's theme

the_remainder_as_pilot.the_fold: after episode 5 (BOUND), the series loops  episode 9 (FULL) begins, then 2 (PAIR), then 6 (BEYOND)... it never terminates

art.use: overlay  all three views merged like the HUD
the horizon  oil ocean, watercolor sky, chipmunk at green line
the bounds  3 and 5, p between, not solvable not statistical ALIVE
the body  Da Vinci Klein fold, green gyro at hips, 20 digits bandwidth

music.use: v1  raw tones encoding p, 21 seconds, the sketch
v2  real music, WAS/IS/NOW as medieval/classical/modern, 58 seconds

production_pipeline.step_1: the data files ARE the script (each JSON = one scene's data)
production_pipeline.step_2: the art IS the keyframes (each generated image = one visual anchor)
production_pipeline.step_3: the music IS the score (each song version = one era's soundtrack)
production_pipeline.step_4: compose: data + art + music ? animated frames
production_pipeline.step_5: the remainder IS the edit  the 0.14159 determines pacing, cuts, rhythm
production_pipeline.step_6: vine distribution  short, composable, grows from the last
production_pipeline.tool_chain: python (synthesis) + ffmpeg (composition) + LSL (interactivity) + Steam Workshop (distribution via Tamison)

episode_formula.fire: the art + music passing through the lattice
episode_formula.the_vine: episode N seeds episode N+1, the starter never stops
